description: How failed conditions are labelled when scoring results. Read these rules from top to bottom; the first match wins. Reference only, not runtime configuration.

condition_rules.if: selected_object(...) or on(...) fails, even with other failures
Only object_in_gripper(...) fails during transport, outside the grasp stage
Only object_in_gripper(...) fails at any other stage (including grasp)
Multiple conditions fail together and neither selected_object(...) nor on(...) failed

condition_rules.meaning: The gripper is not at the pose the stage needs

condition_rules.if: Only gripper_condition = Open or Closed fails (ExecutionSequenceMismatch)
One remaining condition tagged WrongPosition or ContactStateFailure fails (for example inside, next_to, or end_effector_in_contact_with)
One remaining condition tagged WrongObjectSelection or GraspStateFailure fails
No violated condition is identified, or its failure tag is unmapped (for example TaskEffectFailure for open/closed)

note: Grasp versus Slip is inferred from the stage, not proof of when the object was lost. These are condition-scoring rules and individual detector labels; VLM confirmation and combined-method precedence are separate.
